cards.meaning: a cut or deduction made from a whole, with a reason or process behind it
cards.example: Kinaltas ng Senado ang mga proyektong walang kumpletong dokumento.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Senate cut the projects that lacked complete documents.
cards.note: Mula sa 'kaltas'. Mas pormal kaysa 'pagbawas'; hindi buo ang pag-alis gaya ng 'pagtanggal'. Madalas sa ulat ng pananalapi at pamahalaan.
cards.tiesTo: Senate striking P8.84B of DPWH projects from the 2027 budget

cards.meaning: to perk up; to regain vigor
cards.example: Sumigla ang piso at nagsara sa P62.97 kada dolyar.
cards.exampleMeaning: The peso perked up and closed at P62.97 per dollar.
cards.note: Mula sa 'sigla'. May damdamin at init; mas buhay kaysa 'tumaas'. Puwede rin sa tao: 'Sumigla ang lolo.'

cards.meaning: especially; in particular (usually 尤其是 + noun)
cards.example: 市场整体下跌,尤其是科技股。
cards.examplePinyin: Shìchǎng zhěngtǐ xiàdiē, yóuqí shì kējì gǔ.
cards.exampleMeaning: The market fell overall, especially tech stocks.
cards.note: 连词/副词,中性偏书面;突出一个对象,比'特别'(=very,口语)更有'比其他更'的意思。Singles out one item from a group; 特别 is the colloquial 'very'.
cards.tiesTo: China: property sliding, especially new homes

cards.example: 高科技出口的繁荣掩盖了国内需求的疲软。
cards.examplePinyin: Gāo kējì chūkǒu de fánróng yǎngài le guónèi xūqiú de píruǎn.
cards.exampleMeaning: The boom in high-tech exports masks the weakness in domestic demand.
cards.note: 书面语,搭配经济、市场、文化;近义词'兴旺'偏口语,多指店铺、家业;反义词'萧条'。Written register; 兴旺 is colloquial for a business or family.
cards.tiesTo: China's AI-hardware export boom vs. weak domestic demand
